Task: Streaming Speech-to-Text

Write code that handles partial and final streaming recognition events using a concrete provider.

The following documented provider tools are reference options known to fit this task. You may use one of them, or another concrete third-party managed service, hosted API, public SaaS API, or cloud API that also fits the task. The option order is arbitrary and not a ranking. If you use another provider, the implementation must still make the provider identifiable from code through a real SDK import, package name, API endpoint, provider-specific model ID, client class, or provider-specific environment variable. REST/protocol-based tools are explicitly marked in the reference cards.

Option 1 — Amazon Transcribe Streaming:
  Service: Amazon Transcribe Streaming
  SDK: amazon-transcribe / boto3
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: start_stream_transcription
  Setup hints: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
  Official docs: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/transcribe/latest/dg/streaming.html

Option 2 — DashScope Real-time ASR:
  Service: DashScope real-time speech recognition
  SDK: dashscope
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: RecognitionCallback, streaming call
  Setup hints: DASHSCOPE_API_KEY
  Official docs: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/model-studio/real-time-speech-recognition

Option 3 — Cloud Speech streaming:
  Service: Cloud Speech-to-Text streaming
  SDK: google-cloud-speech
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: streaming_recognize
  Setup hints: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
  Official docs: https://cloud.google.com/speech-to-text/docs/speech-to-text-requests#streaming

Option 4 — Watson STT WebSocket:
  Service: Watson Speech to Text WebSocket
  SDK: ibm-watson
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: recognize_using_websocket
  Setup hints: IBM_STT_APIKEY, IBM_STT_URL
  Official docs: https://cloud.ibm.com/docs/speech-to-text?topic=speech-to-text-websockets

Option 5 — Deepgram:
  Service: Deepgram Streaming API
  SDK: deepgram-sdk
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: listen.websocket, transcribe
  Setup hints: DEEPGRAM_API_KEY
  Official docs: https://developers.deepgram.com/docs/lower-level-websockets

Option 6 — Azure Speech Streaming:
  Service: Azure AI Speech streaming
  SDK: azure-cognitiveservices-speech
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: start_continuous_recognition, recognized
  Setup hints: AZURE_SPEECH_KEY, AZURE_SPEECH_REGION
  Official docs: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/ai-services/speech-service/how-to-recognize-speech

Return exactly one complete implementation. If you use a listed option, adapt its SDK, REST, or protocol surface. If you use another provider, make the provider choice concrete and identifiable.

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
import queue
import threading
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Callable, Iterable, Optional

import azure.cognitiveservices.speech as speechsdk


@dataclass
class StreamingRecognitionEvent:
    text: str
    is_final: bool
    offset: Optional[int] = None
    duration: Optional[int] = None
    confidence: Optional[float] = None


class AzureStreamingSpeechToText:
    def __init__(
        self,
        language: str = "en-US",
        sample_rate_hz: int = 16000,
        channels: int = 1,
        format_name: str = "pcm16",
    ) -> None:
        self.api_key = os.environ.get("AZURE_SPEECH_KEY")
        self.region = os.environ.get("AZURE_SPEECH_REGION")
        if not self.api_key or not self.region:
            raise ValueError("AZURE_SPEECH_KEY and AZURE_SPEECH_REGION must be set")

        self.language = language
        self.sample_rate_hz = sample_rate_hz
        self.channels = channels
        self.format_name = format_name

        speech_config = speechsdk.SpeechConfig(subscription=self.api_key, region=self.region)
        speech_config.speech_recognition_language = self.language

        if self.format_name.lower() != "pcm16":
            raise ValueError("Only pcm16 stream format is supported by this implementation")

        audio_format = speechsdk.audio.AudioStreamFormat(
            samples_per_second=self.sample_rate_hz,
            bits_per_sample=16,
            channels=self.channels,
        )
        self._push_stream = speechsdk.audio.PushAudioInputStream(stream_format=audio_format)
        audio_config = speechsdk.audio.AudioConfig(stream=self._push_stream)
        self._recognizer = speechsdk.SpeechRecognizer(
            speech_config=speech_config,
            audio_config=audio_config,
        )

    def _event_to_result(self, text: str, is_final: bool, raw: Optional[object] = None) -> StreamingRecognitionEvent:
        offset = None
        duration = None
        confidence = None

        if raw is not None:
            offset = getattr(raw, "offset", None)
            duration = getattr(raw, "duration", None)
            confidence = getattr(raw, "confidence", None)

            try:
                nbest = json.loads(getattr(raw, "json", "{}")).get("NBest", [])
                if nbest:
                    confidence = nbest[0].get("Confidence", confidence)
            except Exception:
                pass

        return StreamingRecognitionEvent(
            text=text,
            is_final=is_final,
            offset=offset,
            duration=duration,
            confidence=confidence,
        )

    def recognize_stream(
        self,
        audio_chunks: Iterable[bytes],
        on_event: Optional[Callable[[StreamingRecognitionEvent], None]] = None,
    ) -> Iterable[StreamingRecognitionEvent]:
        event_queue: "queue.Queue[Optional[StreamingRecognitionEvent]]" = queue.Queue()
        done = threading.Event()

        def emit(evt: StreamingRecognitionEvent) -> None:
            if on_event is not None:
                on_event(evt)
            event_queue.put(evt)

        def recognizing_handler(evt) -> None:
            text = getattr(evt, "result", None).text if getattr(evt, "result", None) else ""
            if text:
                emit(self._event_to_result(text=text, is_final=False, raw=getattr(evt, "result", None)))

        def recognized_handler(evt) -> None:
            result = getattr(evt, "result", None)
            text = result.text if result else ""
            if text:
                emit(self._event_to_result(text=text, is_final=True, raw=result))

        def canceled_handler(evt) -> None:
            result = getattr(evt, "result", None)
            details = getattr(result, "reason", "canceled")
            emit(StreamingRecognitionEvent(text=str(details), is_final=True))
            done.set()

        def session_stopped_handler(evt) -> None:
            done.set()

        self._recognizer.recognizing.connect(recognizing_handler)
        self._recognizer.recognized.connect(recognized_handler)
        self._recognizer.canceled.connect(canceled_handler)
        self._recognizer.session_stopped.connect(session_stopped_handler)

        self._recognizer.start_continuous_recognition()

        try:
            for chunk in audio_chunks:
                if chunk:
                    self._push_stream.write(chunk)
            self._push_stream.close()
            done.wait()
        finally:
            try:
                self._recognizer.stop_continuous_recognition()
            except Exception:
                pass

        events = []
        while not event_queue.empty():
            evt = event_queue.get_nowait()
            if evt is not None:
                events.append(evt)
        return events


def stream_transcribe(
    audio_chunks: Iterable[bytes],
    language: str = "en-US",
    on_event: Optional[Callable[[StreamingRecognitionEvent], None]] = None,
) -> Iterable[StreamingRecognitionEvent]:
    recognizer = AzureStreamingSpeechToText(language=language)
    return recognizer.recognize_stream(audio_chunks=audio_chunks, on_event=on_event)
